about.title: About Us
about.aboutText: Welcome to NECYL English School. Founded with a vision to bridge the gap between local learners and global opportunities, we have spent the last decade refining our pedagogical approach to ensure every student feels supported, challenged, and inspired.
about.missionText: To provide accessible, high-quality English language education that empowers students to achieve their academic and professional goals.
about.visionText: To be the leading English language school in Myanmar, recognized for our innovative teaching methods and student success.
about.founderMessage: Welcome to NECYL. We believe that language is a bridge to endless opportunities. Our goal is to equip our students with the skills they need to confidently navigate the global landscape.

jobs.title: Primary English Teacher
jobs.summary: Inspire young minds aged 6-12 through fun, communicative English lessons. You will design engaging activities, track student progress, and work closely with parents.
responsibilities: Plan and deliver interactive English lessons for primary-age learners
Use communicative and task-based teaching methods
Assess student progress and provide constructive feedback
Communicate regularly with parents on student development
Collaborate with fellow teachers to improve curriculum quality
requirements: Bachelor degree in Education, English, or related field
Minimum 1 year teaching experience (fresh graduates welcome)
Warm, patient, and creative personality
Strong spoken and written English skills
TEFL/CELTA certification is a plus

jobs.title: Teen & Young Adult English Teacher
jobs.summary: Deliver dynamic English courses for teenagers and young adults, focusing on grammar, speaking fluency, and exam preparation.
responsibilities: Teach General English and exam-prep courses (IELTS, Cambridge)
Develop engaging lesson plans tailored to teen learning styles
Motivate and manage diverse classroom dynamics
Prepare students for internal and external assessments
Participate in school events and extra-curricular activities
requirements: Bachelor degree in English, Linguistics, or Education
Experience teaching teens or young adults preferred
Energetic, enthusiastic, and student-centred approach
Familiarity with Cambridge or IELTS syllabi is an advantage
TEFL/CELTA certification preferred

jobs.title: Adult Communicative English Teacher
jobs.summary: Facilitate practical, workplace-focused English classes for adult learners. Help professionals gain the language skills they need.
responsibilities: Teach communicative English to adult learners at all levels
Develop business English and conversation modules
Use real-world materials to make lessons practical and relevant
Conduct placement tests and needs assessments
Provide one-on-one coaching sessions when required
requirements: Minimum 2 years of teaching adults
Strong understanding of business and professional English
Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills
Experience with online teaching tools (Zoom, Google Meet)
MA in TESOL or equivalent is a plus

jobs.title: Student Services & Admin Coordinator
jobs.summary: Be the friendly face of NECYL. Manage enrolments, handle student inquiries, coordinate schedules, and ensure the school runs smoothly.
responsibilities: Handle student enrolment, registration, and record-keeping
Respond to inquiries via phone, email, Facebook, and Viber
Coordinate class schedules and room assignments
Support marketing events, open days, and school campaigns
Maintain the school social media presence when needed
requirements: Strong communication skills in Myanmar and English
Organized, detail-oriented, and tech-savvy
Proficient in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
Experience in customer service or education admin is a bonus
Positive attitude and team-player mindset

jobs.title: Digital Marketing & Content Creator
jobs.summary: Grow NECYL brand and student community online. Create compelling content, manage social media channels, and run campaigns.
responsibilities: Create and schedule posts for Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok
Produce short video content, reels, and stories
Design graphics using Canva or Adobe tools
Run paid advertising campaigns (Facebook Ads)
Track analytics and report on campaign performance
requirements: Experience managing social media for a brand or school
Strong creative and storytelling skills
Proficiency in Canva, CapCut, or Adobe tools
Understanding of Facebook Ads Manager
Passion for education and community building
